title: UK filing adds dated parent growth, retention and loss disclosures
summary: Newly retrieved November 1 filing adds historical management-reported parent metrics, not current audited group financials. Constructive retention/growth and continued losses balance; maintain 69 and all valuation assumptions.
confirmed: Companies House lists FY ended January 31, 2026 accounts filed November 1; the strategic report was signed October 28.
The report attributes approximately 38% ARR growth, 103% SaaS growth and 123% net dollar retention to Kong, and reports a $45.7M parent consolidated loss and $336.3M accumulated deficit.
The UK entity provides cost-plus services to its parent; its own results are not group SaaS profitability.
uncertain: Group metrics are management statements in a subsidiary strategic report, not separately audited current consolidated group KPIs; measurement periods and definitions are not independently established.
Absolute current ARR, margins, cash flow, diluted shares and IPO terms remain unverified. The $300M ARR model input stays an assumption; no automatic valuation re-rating.
